Changing Settings in a configuration case means that configuration is in force when its actual consumer reads it: Safari runtime Start versus Contest class-load TIME_ALLOWED capture. No inner save compatibility, Demo reachability, whole external domain or native Ruby/Array/clock/graphics behavior acceptance.
